notes.title: New / Updates Beta Version 0.0.4
notes.content:
----- New Updates Beta Version 0.0.4 -----

1) Now depending on the difficulty, you will have a number of lives so that you can revive when you die, in the maximum difficulty you will not be able to revive.
2) In Survival Mode you won't have any lives (for now).
3) You can now hide the Objectives window with the “O” or DPAD down on your controller.

----- Fixed Beta Version 0.0.4 -----

1) Selecting Survival mode with Controller or Space key generated an error, now fixed.

notes.title: New / Updates Beta Version 0.0.3
notes.content:
----- New Updates Beta Version 0.0.3 -----
1) An automatic life recovery system has been added.

2) A difficulty system has been added (Easy, Normal, Hard and Mercenary - Each difficulty has different characteristics):
a. - Number of enemies increases depending on the difficulty.
b. - The life of the enemies will be higher depending on the difficulty.
c. - Money reward for killing enemies will be higher depending on the difficulty (the easier the less money).
d. - Experience reward for killing enemies will be higher depending on the difficulty (the easier the less experience).
and. - Enemies will have a low or high drop rate depending on the difficulty (the easier the higher the drop rate, on Mercenary difficulty they won't drop items).
F. - Automatic health recovery faster or slower depending on the difficulty (the easier the more health you recover, Mercenary mode will not recover health).
g. - You will recover a percentage more of life depending on the difficulty (the easier you recover, the more amount of life).

----- Fixed Beta Version 0.0.3 -----
1) Enemy bullet speed has been adjusted.

notes.title: New / Update Version Beta 0.0.2
notes.content:
-----New / Updates Beta Version 0.0.2-----

1) A shop has been added to buy items on the main island, also the shop is available in each mission in the form of contraband, you will have to get it if you want to buy items in the middle of the mission.

----- Fixed Beta Version 0.0.2 -----

1) In the city a part of the stage was missing, it has been fixed.
2) Fixed a boss spawning on fire and not having a weapon.
